integrity: Proof uses intrinsic residue multiplication pencil and explicit rational identities; the finite computations corroborate, not replace, the general proof. Historical novelty is subject to additional independent literature review.
scientific_limitations: Infinite family of distinct dimension-minimal complex evolution envelopes of the dual-number algebra only; no full classification of all such envelopes or analogous statement over all base fields. One closest plausible preprint was not available as full text during comparison.
title: Infinitely many minimal evolution envelopes of the dual numbers
